note: Read on 24 Nov 2026. The English promotions page https://www.bangkokbank.com/en/personal/cards/credit-cards/promotions is tabbed and paginated (12 tiles per page). It loads the complete public listing https://www.bangkokbank.com/apiaem/content/bangkokbank/en/personal/cards/credit-cards/promotions.allpromo.json (238 items on 24 Nov 2026). That JSON is the recipe start URL. Offer detail pages use h2.promo-detail-title and div.promo-detail-description; the period often appears as Promotion period : Month D, YYYY - Month D, YYYY. Offers whose end date is before the run day are left out of the hand-in. Plain HTTP timed out; Real Chrome is required.
